attributes.action: Equal Criminality Rules for All Nationalities–No Discrimination in UK Settlement
attributes.additional_details: If a spotless criminal record is mandatory for Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR), the same standard must apply fairly to everyone. Every skilled worker deserves equal treatment, regardless of nationality. Minor offences, isolated incidents and serious crimes must be assessed proportionately, considering their circumstances and time elapsed. No discrimination, no double standards. If equal treatment cannot be guaranteed, withdraw the blanket criminality rule.
attributes.background: Apply criminality rules equally to all nationalities and immigration routes. If a spotless criminal record is mandatory for ILR, it must apply fairly to everyone. Minor offences must be assessed proportionately. Equal rules, equal rights, no discrimination. Otherwise, withdraw the blanket rule.

rejection.details: We find this petition unclear - we do not know from your text for whom you think the spotless criminal record requirement (which is yet to be introduced) may not apply.
